title: Only one cat treat
text: I ordered this for two cats expecting to get some value. It is for Multi-Cats (more than one) so I would expect a least two bags of treats.  The toys were cheap really, and when presented to my cats, they refused to eat the included treats, and only one toy, interested one cat, for about one second, she sniffed it.  One cat did get into the emptied box and play with it, so the box was the most  exciting part of the treats and goodies, on Christmas morning.  Very disappointing.  Yes I purchased it here at Amazon; can't seem to give feedback on my original order, perhaps because I cancelled the original subscription.
label: negative
